column1: # American -> British rules.  Original work for this spike (hand curated); no third-party licence.
#   layer  S = spelling homograph (applies when spelling is on)
#          V = vocabulary, "safe" tier      X = vocabulary, "extended" tier (assumption about the text)
#   source words, lower case; "a|b" pairs with "x|y" in target; "#" = a number; "'s" = possessive
#          a space matches a space, "-" matches a hyphen
#   target replacement, or "=" to freeze the source as it is
#   guards p+ / p- previous token is / is not in the list     n+ / n- next token
#          s+ / s- the sentence contains / does not contain one of the words
#          d-      the whole text does not contain one of the words
#          list tokens: words, "#" number, "|" boundary (start, end, punctuation), "'s", "-"
#          "title" = the first word must be Capitalised in the text
# program -> programme, except the verb, and except when the text talks about computing
# tire -> tyre only when it is clearly the wheel
# check -> cheque only in fixed money phrases
